_why: The SHOP TYPES: what each kind of NPC shop is allowed to sell. A shop file (stock.json for the Black Market witch, or shops/<shop_id>.json for a future NPC) names its type with "type": "food" and the validator (ShopType.java, StockSchema.java) rejects every item line whose item or tag is not of that type, so the baker never gets a netherite block on his shelf. A type allows an item when the item is not in banned_ids AND one of these holds: "all" is true (the general store), the item id is in "ids", the item's namespace is in "namespaces", or the item carries one of the "tags" (a tag also allows its children: c:ores allows c:ores/iron). A TAG line of a shop file is allowed when the tag itself is allowed. To make a new type just add an entry here (a datapack can replace the file and /reload); a type needs at least one of all, tags, namespaces or ids. Tags that no mod provides are harmless: a line that names an empty tag simply makes no slot. Keys that start with an underscore are comments.

types._general: The Black Market witch: she sells a bit of everything the world and the modpack have, minus the items that must never be bought for gold (creative-only blocks, and the catalysts of the relic upgrade ritual, which the dungeon is meant to give out).
types._food: A cook or a baker: crops and everything edible, plus the dungeon's raw meats.
types._ores: A miner or a smelter: ores, raw ore, ingots, nuggets, gems and dusts, never the finished goods made of them.
types._potions: An alchemist: potion bottles and the brewing reagents. Note: a purchase hands over the item's DEFAULT stack, so a potion line gives the plain bottle; brewed potions are not a shop good yet.
types._tools: A smith of tools: pickaxes, axes, shovels, hoes, swords and the small tools.
types._armor: An armourer: helmets, chestplates, leggings and boots, and shields.
types._magic: A magic dealer: everything of Tensura, plus the vanilla goods of enchanting and the end.
types._building: A mason or a carpenter: logs, planks, stone, bricks, wool, glass and the blocks cut from them.
types._materials: A hunter's broker: what monsters drop (hides, bones, string, feathers, slime), the Tensura monster parts and the magic stones and crystals.
